findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_follow_up_text, call_scorecard · Private data: call_scorecard, conversation_signals · Public sink: roleplay_card.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_follow_up_text, call_scorecard · Private data: call_scorecard, conversation_signals · Public sink: roleplay_card

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "dealership_glossary" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Plain definitions of the 84 terms in the Pinpoint sales conversation glossary, from appointment set rate to speed to lead and quiet hours. Accepts a term's other names too. Returns the matching term, or the closest matches." → after: "Plain definitions of the 92 terms in the Pinpoint sales conversation glossary, from appointment set rate to speed to lead and quiet hours. Accepts a term's other names too. Returns the matching term, or the closest matches."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
